fixes.explanation: Bethlehem isn't in her question, friend. Naomi says she is too old to have another husband (Ruth 1:12). Then she asks, “…would you wait for them to grow up?” (Ruth 1:13) She's picturing a husband and sons, even if she somehow had hope for both tonight. I think she's laying it all out because she wants them to go home.

Egypt isn't stamped anywhere in this verse, friend. The family went to reside in the land of Moab (Ruth 1:1), and verse 2 says they entered Moab and settled there (Ruth 1:2). Egypt is a good guess when a famine hits, but Moab is the one the text gives.
